Include the 30-60% window/template dependence of the blend integral in its uncertainty.

notes_for_questioner: (1) The Sblue/S blue wing is real but uncleaned: can a joint Xb4d+Xb4b analysis (or the Xb4b manual-image cube) bound the true wing flux and the HCN/HCO+ ratio in the wing (high ratio expected from shock chemistry, Nishimura+2024)? Ratios from lower-limit wing fluxes are not yet usable. (2) The N-S systemic offset +71+-28 km/s is only 2.5 sigma; is it needed later? (3) A matched-beam (5.84x3.52 arcsec) HCN/HCO+ 3-2 flux comparison across Xb4b/4d/4f would give the resolved-out fraction for lines, not only continuum, before any ladder ratio mixes arrays. (4) N and S are unresolved from each other in Band 5 and marginally in Band 7, so per-nucleus 2-1 and 4-3 ratios need a blend model; the research question may be answerable only as N+S vs the rest at J=2-1.
